sources.name: Europe PMC Open Access subset
sources.license_rule: Read each article's license metadata. Include only individually eligible licenses; do not assume all Europe PMC records are reusable.

sources.name: PubMed
sources.license_rule: Abstract availability does not mean the abstract is public domain or licensed for model training. Track rights per record and do not bulk-train on unknown rights.

sources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
sources.license_rule: Public registry records are useful for trial metadata and study status; inspect applicable data-use terms and third-party content before training.

sources.name: WHO publications
sources.license_rule: WHO copyright and reuse terms vary by publication. Do not treat free-to-read as permission to train; record the exact publication license or written permission.

sources.name: CDC publications
sources.license_rule: US government works may be public domain, but third-party figures, photos, and incorporated materials can have separate rights. Verify each item.
